name: $sha256Binary

name: $compileBinary
description: Compiles a bot into a standalone executable or portable bundle and returns its path. Requires `new Graak({ allowCompile: true })`

args.name: entrypoint
args.description: Built JavaScript entrypoint of the bot, relative to the bot root

args.name: output
args.description: Output file (sea) or directory (portable), relative to the bot root

args.name: packageManager
args.description: Package manager (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn), detected from the project when empty

name: $dbDriverCompat
description: Returns whether the installed ForgeDB driver of the bot can run on a target (native drivers need an addon built for it)

args.name: driver
args.description: ForgeDB database type (sqlite, better-sqlite3, mongodb, mysql, postgres), defaults to sqlite

name: $graakVersion
description: Returns the installed Graak version

name: $suggestDbDriver
description: Returns a pure JavaScript ForgeDB driver to switch to when `driver` is native (empty string when it already is one)

args.name: driver
args.description: ForgeDB database type (sqlite, better-sqlite3, mongodb, mysql, postgres)

name: $canPackageOnBun
description: Returns whether a target is one Bun cannot compile itself (32-bit or legacy), so Graak is the way to build it

name: $isTargetSupported
description: Returns whether Graak builds a target for the given or detected package manager

args.name: packageManager
args.description: Package manager (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn), detected from the project when empty

name: $packageManager
description: Returns the package manager or runtime the project uses (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn)

name: $packagerType
description: Returns the default build strategy of a target: native when it runs on the Graak native host, otherwise sea when an official Node.js runtime is downloadable, portable if not

name: $supportedTargets
description: Returns the targets Graak builds for a package manager

args.name: packageManager
args.description: Package manager (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn), detected from the project when empty

name: $binaryArchitecture
description: Returns the CPU architecture of a target (x86, x64, armv7, arm64)

name: $binaryExtension
description: Returns the executable file extension of a target (.exe for Windows, empty otherwise)

name: $binaryFormat
description: Returns the executable format of a target (elf32, elf64, pe32, pe32plus, macho)

name: $is32BitOrLegacy
description: Returns whether a target is 32-bit (iSH, x86, ARMv7) or legacy Windows (7 / Vista)

name: $is32BitTarget
description: Returns whether a target uses a 32-bit CPU architecture

name: $is64BitTarget
description: Returns whether a target uses a 64-bit CPU architecture

name: $isArmTarget
description: Returns whether a target uses an ARM CPU (armv7 or arm64)

name: $isIsh
description: Returns whether a target is the 32-bit iSH emulator on iOS

name: $isLegacyWindows
description: Returns whether a target is legacy Windows (7 / Vista)

name: $listPlatforms
description: Returns every Graak target identifier

name: $targetBits
description: Returns the bitness of a target (32 or 64)

name: $targetDescription
description: Returns the human-readable description of a target

name: $targetName
description: Returns the display name of a target

name: $targetPlatform
description: Returns the operating system family of a target (ios-ish, windows-legacy, windows, linux, darwin, freebsd)
